exposure: maternal smoking (current or quit during pregnancy)
cohort: The study included newborns and their mothers, selected by convenience from users of the public health system in Francisco Beltrao, Parana, Brazil, with cases weighing <= 2,500 g and controls weighing > 2,500 g, paired by sex and date of birth.
finding: Lower gestational week and fathers' educational level (high school or above) were significantly associated with lower chances of low birth weight.
gest_age: Measured as a continuous variable; lower gestational weeks were associated with low birth weight.
